title: L'Arrestation d'Arsène Lupin
author: Maurice Leblanc
blurb: A transatlantic liner, a wireless telegram, and a gentleman-thief hiding somewhere among the first-class passengers.

title: Le Bal
author: Irène Némirovsky
blurb: Paris, the 1920s. A newly rich mother throws a grand ball and bans her fourteen-year-old daughter from it. The daughter has two hundred invitations to post.

title: Micromégas
author: Voltaire
blurb: Two giants, one from Sirius and one from Saturn, visit our tiny planet and discover that its mites can think.
